decisions.reason: Although later website visibility is unclear, transactional email is central to the firm's cloud communications strategy, so management would keep this strategically important option unless clear underperformance emerges.

After several years, a document capture and recognition service appears more adjacent and likely more demanding to develop than the core messaging stack, so management would now redeploy resources to stronger core or newer options.

Multi-engine virus scanning remains a close security complement for regulated communications and is easier to preserve as a modular add-on than a stand-alone growth bet, so the firm would likely keep it for now.
